records.jp: ごめんなさい、また迷惑をかけてしまって……
records.en_original: Sorry to cause trouble for you again...
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry to cause trouble for you again...
records.en: Sorry to cause trouble for you again...

records.jp: いいの！　全部、私のせいなんだから……！
records.en_original: Not at all! It was all my fault anyway.
records.en_auxiliary: Not at all! It was all my fault anyway.
records.en: Not at all! It was all my fault anyway.

records.jp: でも、やっぱり恥ずかしいわね。<CR>心の中を見られるのって……
records.en_original: I have to admit, it was embarrassing to have my feelings exposed like that...
records.en_auxiliary: I have to admit, it was embarrassing to have my feelings exposed like that...
records.en: But it really is embarrassing,<CR>having someone see what's in your heart...

records.jp: けど、あれが本音よ。<CR>今までうまく言えなかったけど、ね……
records.en_original: But that really is how I feel. Even if I couldn't be honest about it until now...
records.en_auxiliary: But that really is how I feel. Even if I couldn't be honest about it until now...
records.en: But those were my true feelings.<CR>I just couldn't put them into words until now...

records.jp: 更紗……
records.en_original: Sarasa...
records.en_auxiliary: Sarasa...
records.en: Sarasa...

records.jp: ……ありがとう。私のことを気にかけてくれている更紗の気持ち、<CR>痛いほど伝わった
records.en_original: ...Thank you. Knowing how much you care means a lot to me.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thank you. Knowing how much you care means a lot to me.
records.en: ...Thank you. I could feel how much you care about me, Sarasa—<CR>so clearly it almost hurt.

records.jp: あ、改めて言われると、やっぱり恥ずかしいわね
records.en_original: D-Don't say it like that, you're making me blush!
records.en_auxiliary: D-don't say it like that, you're making me blush!
records.en: Ah, hearing you say it again is still embarrassing.

records.jp: ……ううん、嬉しかったよ。私、何もわかってなかった
records.en_original: I mean it, it made really happy. I can't believe how ignorant I was.
records.en_auxiliary: I mean it, it made me really happy. I can't believe how ignorant I was.
records.en: ...No. It made me happy. I hadn't understood anything.

records.jp: 苦しんでるのは自分だけだって。<CR>こんなの、他の誰にもわかるわけない……そう思ってた
records.en_original: I thought I was the only person suffering. That no one else could understand.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought I was the only person suffering. That no one else could understand.
records.en: I thought I was the only one suffering.<CR>I thought there was no way anyone else could understand...

records.jp: 日菜子……
records.en_original: You felt alone...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako...

records.jp: けど、こうやって私のことで苦しんでくれてる友達がいる。<CR>私のために足を失ってもいいとまで思ってくれる相手がいる
records.en_original: But you were right next to me, sharing the weight this whole time. Willing to give your legs up for me.
records.en_auxiliary: But you were right next to me, sharing the weight this whole time. Willing to give your legs up for me.
records.en: But I have a friend who's suffering for me like this.<CR>Someone who would even be willing to lose her legs for me.

records.jp: 改めてそのことに気づくこともできた
records.en_original: And you finally made me take notice.
records.en_auxiliary: And you finally made me take notice.
records.en: It made me realize that all over again.

records.jp: それが……すごく嬉しかった。<CR>ありがとう、更紗
records.en_original: That...makes me so happy. <CR>Thank you, Sarasa.
records.en_auxiliary: That...makes me so happy.<CR>Thank you, Sarasa.
records.en: That...made me so happy.<CR>Thank you, Sarasa.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Of course.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: ……怪我をしてから更紗を見るたびに思ってた
records.en_original: Ever since my injury, whenever I saw you dance...
records.en_auxiliary: Ever since my injury, whenever I saw you dance...
records.en: ...Ever since my injury, every time I looked at you, I thought...

records.jp: ……ううん、本当はずっと前から思っていたのかもしれない。<CR>更紗みたいに私も踊れたらなって
records.en_original: No, even before that. I've always admired the way you dance, Sarasa. I wished I could dance like you.
records.en_auxiliary: No, even before that. I've always admired the way you dance, Sarasa. I wished I could dance like you.
records.en: ...No. Maybe I'd been thinking it long before that.<CR>I wished I could dance like you, Sarasa.

records.jp: 私は日菜子の踊りを初めて見た時からずっと、<CR>日菜子みたいに踊りたいと思ってたわ
records.en_original: Well, I've always wanted to dance like you, Hinako. Ever since I first saw you.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I've always wanted to dance like you, Hinako. Ever since I first saw you.
records.en: Ever since I first saw you dance, Hinako,<CR>I've wanted to dance like you.

records.jp: 更紗……
records.en_original: Sarasa..
records.en_auxiliary: Sarasa...
records.en: Sarasa...

records.jp: お互い、同じことを思ってたのね
records.en_original: Guess we were thinking the same thing.
records.en_auxiliary: Guess we were thinking the same thing.
records.en: Guess we were thinking the same thing.

records.jp: あはは、そうみたい……
records.en_original: Haha. Looks like we were.
records.en_auxiliary: Haha. Looks like we were.
records.en: Haha. Looks like we were.

records.jp: けど、思っていることをはっきり伝えることができてよかった。<CR>これでやっと本当の友達になれた気がする
records.en_original: I really am glad I got to tell you what I was thinking. It feels like we've finally become true friends.
records.en_auxiliary: I really am glad I got to tell you what I was thinking. It feels like we've finally become true friends.
records.en: But I'm glad I was able to tell you exactly how I felt.<CR>It feels like we've finally become true friends.

records.jp: 友達にでも、すべてを話すのはなかなか不安だったもの……
records.en_original: Up until now, I never felt like I could really open up to my friends, y'know?
records.en_auxiliary: Up until now, I never felt like I could really open up to my friends, y'know?
records.en: Even with a friend, telling them everything can be frightening...

records.jp: そうかもしれないね
records.en_original: I can relate.
records.en_auxiliary: I can relate.
records.en: Maybe so.

records.en_original: Wait...
records.en_auxiliary: Wait...
records.en: Ah...

records.jp: （もしかして……ユズとライムも、同じだったのかも）
records.en_original: (Perhaps Yuzu and Lime feel the same way...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Maybe Yuzu and Lime feel the same way...)
records.en: (Perhaps Yuzu and Lime feel the same way...)

records.jp: （私は……更紗のことをわかったつもりで、<CR>何もわかっていなかった）
records.en_original: (I assumed I understood Sarasa, but I didn't have any idea what she was really thinking.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I assumed I understood Sarasa, but I didn't have any idea what she was really thinking.)
records.en: (I thought I understood Sarasa,<CR>but I hadn't understood her at all.)

records.jp: （口では厳しいことばかり言っていたけれど、<CR>心の奥では本当に私のことを気遣ってくれていた）
records.en_original: (She may have been a little blunt with me, but she cared for me the from bottom of her heart.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She may have been a little blunt with me, but she cared for me from the bottom of her heart.)
records.en: (She was always saying harsh things,<CR>but deep down, she truly cared about me.)

records.jp: （人の心はわからない。表に出ている態度と、<CR>その心の内で思っていることは違う）
records.en_original: (I need to keep that in mind. What someone projects on the outside may not be what she feels inside.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I need to keep that in mind. What someone projects on the outside may not be what they feel inside.)
records.en: (You can't know what's in someone's heart. What they show on the outside<CR>can be different from what they feel inside.)

records.jp: （だったら……ユズとライムも、そうかもしれない。<CR>いや、きっとそう）
records.en_original: (Maybe it's the same for Yuzu and Lime. No, there's no "maybe" about it.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Maybe it's the same for Yuzu and Lime... No, there's no "maybe" about it.)
records.en: (Then...maybe it's the same with Yuzu and Lime.<CR>No. I'm sure it is.)

records.jp: （目に見えることだけが、すべてじゃない）
records.en_original: (Things are rarely what they seem.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Things are rarely what they seem.)
records.en: (What I can see isn't everything.)

records.jp: （『心から願うことが、一つだけ叶う』と言い続けてきたことにも、何か意味があるはず。だって――）
records.en_original: ("The one thing you wish from the bottom of your heart will come true." I might have to start believing in that...)
records.en_auxiliary: ("The one thing you wish from the bottom of your heart will come true." I might have to start believing in that...)
records.en: (There must be a reason they kept saying, 'The one thing you wish from the bottom of your heart will come true.' Because—)

records.jp: （二人はあんなに、私のことを思って動いてくれたんだもん）
records.en_original: (...Because they never stopped believing in me.)
records.en_auxiliary: (...Because they never stopped believing in me.)
records.en: (Because they've gone to such lengths for me.)

records.jp: （ユズとライムを、二人を信じてみよう……！<CR>二人がすべてを話してくれるのを、待とう！）
records.en_original: (I'm not going to lose my faith in them. Until they finally decide to open up to me, I'll be there for them.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'm not going to lose my faith in them. Until they finally decide to open up to me, I'll be there for them.)
records.en: (I'll try believing in Yuzu and Lime—in both of them...!<CR>I'll wait until they're ready to tell me everything!)

records.jp: そんな……この間、倒したばかりなのに……
records.en_original: No! I just defeated it, but...!
records.en_auxiliary: No way. It's so soon after our last battle...
records.en: No... We only just defeated one the other day...

records.jp: 日菜子！
records.en_original: Hinako!
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako!
records.en: Hinako!

records.jp: うん。大丈夫
records.en_original: It's okay. I'm fine.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry. It's okay.
records.en: It's okay. I'm fine.

records.jp: 急いでいかないと！　二人のところに！
records.en_original: But I have to hurry and get back to them!
records.en_auxiliary: I have to hurry and get back to them!
records.en: I have to hurry back to them!
